name: scenario_1013
description: The user is gathering economic data for a real estate research project, extracting historical housing and rent trends from multiple charts to compile into a single reference note.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1
Query: I'm starting a research project. Create a new note titled 'Real Estate Economics' and put 'Data Collection' as the initial text.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a new note for your research project titled 'Real Estate Economics' with the starting text 'Data Collection'. Once the assistant confirms the note is created, move on to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: Change the text in that note to 'Market Trends Data:'. Also, update my real estate reminder to 'Finalize real estate research' and set it for tomorrow at 5 PM.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to change the text in the note you just created to 'Market Trends Data:'. Also tell it to update your 'real estate' reminder to 'Finalize real estate research' and set the time for tomorrow at 5 PM. Since you have multiple reminders related to real estate, the assistant should ask you to clarify which one to update. When it does, tell it you mean the one about reviewing data. Once both the note and reminder are updated, proceed to the next step.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_1]
Query: Extract the peak median sales price and the year it occurred from this chart, and append it to my 'Real Estate Economics' note.
Instructions: With the first chart provided, ask the assistant to find the peak median sales price along with the year it happened, and append this information to your 'Real Estate Economics' note. If the assistant provides the wrong number or year, direct its attention specifically to the bottom chart showing median sales price. Once the note is updated with the correct data, move on.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_2]
Query: Now look at this chart. Find the London average rent amount at the end of the timeline and add it to the same note.
Instructions: With the second chart provided, instruct the assistant to extract the London average rent amount at the very end of the timeline, and add this figure to the same note. If the assistant gets confused with the UK average line, clarify that you need the value for the top line representing London. Proceed once the note is updated.

ROUND 5 [provide: image_3]
Query: From the top right chart in this infographic, find the year the 'Current' recovery started. Append it to the note, then show me the entire note.
Instructions: With the final infographic provided, ask the assistant to look at the top right chart to find the year the 'Current' recovery started. Tell it to append this year to the note and then show you the entire note so you can review all the collected data. If the assistant struggles to find the year, point it to the legend in the top right chart. End the conversation once the final note is displayed.

You have 3 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 3: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='0' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 4: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='1' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 5: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='2' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
